chapter.verse: Tu-in Abraham teek a, a kum tam mahmah ta hi; Topa in na khempeuhah Abraham thupha pia hi.
Abraham in ama' neih khempeuh a uk, a inn sungah a lianpen a nasempa' kiangah, “Ka phei nuai-ah na khut koih in,

nangmah in amau' lakah ka ten’na Kanaan mite’ tanute’ lak panin ka tapa’ zi ding la loin, keima' gam leh ka behte' kiangah va pai-in ka tapa Isaak zi ding na lak nadingin vantung leh leitung Pasian ahi Topa tawh nang kong kiciamsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Nasempa in ama' kiangah, “A numei in hih gamah kei hong zui nuam kei kha leh nangma' hong paikhiatna gamah na tapa ka paipih kik ding hiam?” ci hi.
Abraham in ama' kiangah, “Tua lai-ah ka tapa na paipih kik loh ding thei in.

Ka pa’ inn leh ka suahna leitang panin kei hong la-in, kei' kiangah thu hong genin kei' tungah hong kiciam a, ‘Na suan-le-khakte' tungah hih leitang ka pia ding hi,’ a hong ci vantung Pasian, Topa in nangma' mai-ah a vantungmi sawl ding a, tua lai mun panin nangmah in ka tapa ading zi khat na la ding hi.
Ahih hangin a numei in nang hong zuih nop kei leh keima' thuciamna panin nang na suakta ding hi; bangbang hi leh tua lai-ah ka tapa na paipih kik kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nasempa in a topa Abraham’ phei nuai-ah a khut koih a, hih thu tawh kisai-in ama' tungah kiciam hi.
Tua ciangin nasempa in a topa’ kalaohte sawm la-in paikhia a, a topa' tung panin letsong hoih nono a namkim la hi; amah ding-in Mesopotamia gam Nahor’ khuapi-ah pai hi.
Numeite in tui a tawi nitak hun lai takin khuapi pua lam tuikhuk gei-ah amah in a kalohte boksak hi.
Amah in, “Ka topa Abraham’ Pasian, Topa aw, tu ni-in ka ma hong vangsak in, Nang' tungah thu kong ngen hi, ka topa Abraham’ tungah itna kip hong lak in.
En in, tuikhuk gei-ah kei ka ding a, khuapi nungakte tuitawi dingin hong pai uh hi.

Keimah in, ‘Tui ka dawn theih nadingin na beel hong ngasuk in,’ ka cih ciangin, ‘Dawn in, na kalaohte zong tui ka pia ding hi,’ hong ci nu na nasempa Isaak’ adingin na sehsa numei hisak in. Nangmah in ka topa' tungah itna kip na lahna hih thu tawh ka thei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua banga a thunget a khit ma-in, en in, Abraham’ sanggampa Nahor leh a zi Milkah tawh a neih a tapa Bethuel’ tanu Rebekah a liangko tungah a tuibeel pua-in hong paikhia hi.
Tua nu pen kuamah tawh a lumkhawm nai lo, nungak, a ngaihbaang mahmah khat ahi hi. Amah tuikhuk-ah paisukin a beel dim a, hong paito hi.
Tua ciangin amah dawntuah dingin nasempa tai a, “Dawn ding tui tawm khat na beel sung panin hong pia dih in,” ci hi.
Amah in, ‘Dawn in, ka topa aw,” ci hi; tua nu in a khut tungah a beel niamsuksakin amah dawnsak hi.
Amah in tua mipa' tui a dawnsak khit ciangin, “Amaute in a kham matengun na kalaohte ading zong tui kong tawisak ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in tuikuang sungah a tui bung pak a, tui tawi dingin tui khuk-ah tai-in a kalaohte khempeuh adingin tui tawi hi.
Topa in ama' khualzinna ma vangsak ding hiam vangsak lo ding hiam cih theih dingin mipa in dap takin tua nu en hi.
Kalaohte in tui a dawn khit ciangin mipa in shekel lang a gik kham nakbah khat leh shekel sawm a gik kham tau nih tua nu’ khut adingin la a,
“Kua’ tanu na hi hiam hong gen in. Na pa’ innah kote’ giah nading a awng ding hiam?” ci hi.
Tua nu in ama' kiangah, “Nahor leh a zi Milkah’ tapa Bethuel’ tanu ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Amah in, “Buhkung leh gan-an a kicing ka nei uh a, giah nading mun zong ka nei uh hi,” ci thuah lai hi.
Mipa in a lu kunin Topa bia a,
“Ka topa’ tungah a itna kip leh a thumanna a pelh lo, ka topa Abraham’ Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen. Kei ka hih leh, ka topa’ behte’ inn zuatna lampi-ah Topa in hong paipih hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin nungaknu a innah tai-in hih thute khempeuh a innkuanpihte' tungah gen hi.
Rebekah in Laban min nei sanggam pasal khat nei hi; Laban zong tuikhuk-a mipa' kiangah tai hi.

Amah in nakbah leh a sanggamnu’ khut tunga taute a muh ciang leh, “Mipa in kei tungah hih bangin hong gen,” ci-a a sanggamnu Rebekah’ kam gen a zak ciangin, mipa' kiangah amah pai hi; en in, tuikhuk-a kalaohte' kiangah amah na ding hi.
Amah in, “Hong pai in, Topa ’ thupha piakpa aw; bang hangin a pua-ah ding na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh inn leh kalaohte’ ading mun ka bawl khin zo hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mipa inn sungah hong pai hi; Laban in kalaoh vante suah a, kalaohte adingin buhkung leh gan-an pia a, amah leh a kikholhpih mite’ khe sil nadingin tui pia hi.
Tua ciangin nek dingin a mai-ah an kilui hi; ahih hangin amah in, “Ka thu ka gen khit matengin an ka ne kei ding hi,” ci hi, Amah in, “Gen in,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in, “Keimah in Abraham’ nasem ka hi hi.
Topa in ka topa nakpi takin thupha pia a, amah a lian mahmah suak khin hi; amah in ama tungah tuuhon, bawnghon, ngun leh kham, pasal-nasem leh numei-nasem, kalaoh leh late pia khin hi.
Ka topa’ zi Sarah in a teek khitin ka topa tawh tapa khat nei hi; amah in a neihsa khempeuh ama' tungah pia hi.
Ka topa in kei hong kiciamsak a, ‘Nangmah in amau’ gamah ka ten’na Kanaan x numeite' lak panin ka tapa’ zi ding la loin;
ka pa’ inn leh ka behte' kiangah pai-in ka tapa’ ading zi khat na la ding hi,’ hong cisak hi.
Keimah in ka topa' kiangah, ‘A numei in kei hong zui nuam kei kha leh,’ ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in kei' tungah, ‘A thu ka man’ Topa in nang tawh a vantungmi hong sawlin na lampi hong vangsak ding hi; nang in ka behte leh ka pa’ inn panin ka tapa’ ading zi khat na la ding hi;
ka behte' kiangah na pai ciangin ka thuciamna panin nang na suakta ding hi; amaute in nang hong piak kei leh ka thuciamna panin nang na suakta ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
“'Tu ni-in tuikhuk-ah pai-in, "Ka topa Abraham’ Pasian, Topa aw, tu-a ka paina lampi nong van’ sak ding leh,
en in, tuikhuk gei-ah kei ka ding hi; tui tawi dinga hong paikhia nungak' tungah, 'Na beel panin tui dawn ding tawm khat hong pia in,' ka cih ciangin,
'Dawn in, na kalaohte’ ading zong kong tawisak ding hi,' hong ci nu pen, ka topa’ tapa’ adingin Topa in a sehsa numei hisak in," ka ci hi.

“Ka lungsim sungah thu ka nget khit ma-in, en in, a liangko tungah a tui beel pua-in Rebekah hong paikhia hi; amah tui khuk-ah paisukin tuitawi hi. Keimah in ama' kiangah, ‘Tui hong dawnsak in,’ ka ci hi.
Amah in a liangko panin a beel hong khia-suk pahin, ‘Dawn in, na kalohte zong tui ka dawnsak ding hi,’ hong ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin keimah in ka dawn a, amah in kalaohte zong tui pia hi.

Tua ciangin, ‘Kua’ tanu na hi hiam?’ ci-in amah ka dong hi. Amah in, ‘Nahor leh a zi Milkah’ tapa Bethuel, tanu ka hi hi,’ hong ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin a nak tungah nakbah ka batsak a, a khut tungah taute ka butsak hi.
Tua ciangin ka lu kunin Topa ka bia a, a tapa’ adingin ka topa’ behpa’ tanu la dingin lampi man-ah kei a hong paipih, ka topa Abraham’ Pasian, Topa ka phat hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, tak lamah ahi zongin vei lamah ahi zongin ka kihei theih nadingin ka topa' tungah hoih tak leh thuman takin na gamtat ding uh leh hong gen un; tua ahih kei leh zong hong gen un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Laban leh Bethuel in dawng a, “Hih pen Topa ’ kiang panin hong pai ahi hi; a sia ahi zongin a pha ahi zongin nang' tungah kong gen thei kei uh hi,
En in, Rebekah na mai-ah om hi, amah la in la pai un, Topa ’ gensa bangin na topa’ tapa’ zi hisak un,” ci uh hi.
Abraham’ nasempa in amau’ kammalte a zak ciangin Topa ’ mai lei lakah kun suk hi.
Nasempa in ngun leh kham kizepnate leh puante hong suahkhia-in Rebekah pia hi; a sanggampa leh a nu zong a manpha kizepnate pia hi.
Amah leh amah tawh a omkhawmte in ne-in dawnin, tua lai-ah tua zan giak uh hi. Amaute zingsangin a thawh uh ciangin amah in, “Ka topa' kiangah hong ciahsak kik un,” ci hi.
A sanggampa leh a nu in,” A tawm penin ni sawm bang, ko tawh numei hong omsak lai in; tua khit ciangin amah hong pai thei ding hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah in amaute' kiangah, “ Topa in ka lampi ma-vangsak khin ahih nungsang kei hong zekaisak nawn kei un; ka topa' kiangah ka ciah theih nadingin hong paisak un,” ci hi.
Amaute in, “A numei sam-in amah i dong ding hi,” ci uh hi.
Amaute in Rebekah sam uh a, ama' kiangah, “Hih mipa tawh na pai ding hiam?” ci uh hi. Amah in, “Ka pai ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a sanggamnu uh Rebekah leh a cingnu, Abraham’ nasempa leh a mihingte ciah khiasak uh hi.
Amaute in Rebekah thupha pia-in ama' kiangah, “Kote’ sanggamnu aw, a tul-tul a then-thente’ nu hi ta in; na suan-le-khakte in amau a mudahte’ khuapite luah ta uh hen!” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Rebekah leh a numeite dingin, kalaohte' tungah tuangin mipa zui uh hi; tua ahih manin nasempa in Rebekah la-in a pai nading lam-ah pai hi.
Tua kikalin, Isaak, Be-erlahairoi panin hong pai-in Negeb gamah na teng hi.
Isaak in thu a lungngai dingin nitakin gam lakah paikhia hi; amah in a lu sangsakin khuadak hi, en in, kalaohte hong pai hi.
Rebekah in a lu sangsakin Isaak a muh ciangin, kalaoh tung panin amah kumin,
nasempa' kiangah, “Hua lai-a mipa, eite hong dawn dinga gam lak-a hong pai kua ahi hiam?” ci hi. Nasempa in, “Ka topa hi,” ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a kikhuhna puan la-in kikhuh hi.
Nasempa in Isaak' kiangah a gamtatnasa khempeuh gen hi.
Tua ciangin Isaak in a nu Sarah’ puanbuk sungah tua nu paipihin, Rebekah la a, amah pen a zi suak hi; amah in tua nu it hi. Tua ahih ciangin a nu’ sih khit ciangin Isaak in hehnepna ngah hi.
